# A6e results (generated by sharma_qi.py; do not edit)

Editorial analysis. Residuals in ln g_obs against McCulloch 2017 Eq. 8 with first-order error propagation. Δ(−ln L) values are conditional on this approximate likelihood; bootstrap fractions are not p-values.
